posts.name: Tegre
posts.cooked:
So my earlier guesses were mostly wrong (ok I did get Ambuscade and again I hope he has less Suck - considering there seems to be ranged involved, I think he'll play out MUCH better in Tactics than in SotM)  The Environment Effects made me grumble a bit, but I'm glad that they are there.  While I wish it were Mister Fixer for the 155 stretch goal - The Proletariat with 6 minis does seem like a better upgrade.

 

Update 8 talking about the happenings of the universe seals the deal for me, I always love knowing what's going on, and I'm glad the story will continue in Tactics beyond SotM. I really wish we got more story somedays, so I'm looking forward also to the comic book like instructions.

So this is what I think are the next stretch goals

170 - Everyone is saying "The Citizens" I like this answer and I'll lean toward it.  Initially because there were only nine sillouettes I thought "Oh the Ennead! We've got Ra so who better for the FV and Ra to fight against."  However, Dawn does need her own posse to roll with and with everyone pointing out all of the random heads arms and legs poking out of other places, the Citizens does seem like a better answer.

185 - I'll say Expatriette.  Here's why. First  Ambuscade's character is a character that would benefit from switching weapons and making "ranged" and Melee attacks.  The Sillouette for the 185 character is drawn in a way to hide what could be important details.  While one hand looks like its on her hip - the other hand looks...big. Is it a hand cannon? Is it a bazooka?  Expatriette would be another "Gun Toting" character that could switch weapons to affect different ranges and different tactics as well as benefit from different weapons and tactics.  Sure powers could be changed/adapted to represent these things, but she's also one of a few characters who people are polarized on from the card game.  At the same time - a character that would probably play very differently on a tabletop version of the game.  My only other guess at the moment? Unity. Why? See below.

200 - Unity's bots make sense as that does look like raptor bot in the mix of them as well as the original FV.  However shouldn't there be a Unity Sillouette included?  If not... than that would mean that 185 isn't Expatriette but actually Unity and her bots would be another goal altogether (lets face it, if you didn't get a plush Mr. Chomps over the holidays, than how could you say no to a miniatures version of Mr. Chomps?)
